svg.title: 12b New RFQ for PR-2026-0091
svg.text: from PR-2026-0091 Desks and chairs, Kamuli ICT centre · approved 9 Oct

g.text: Request for quotations · UGX 18.6M · 3 quotes or more
Delivery within 21 days of the LPO. Payment 30 days after accepted delivery. 1-year warranty on frames and tops. Quote in UGX,
VAT shown separately; prices valid for 60 days.

svg.text: Lowest price among quotations that meet the specification
Quality and price, scored by an evaluation committee (required above UGX 30M)
Prequalified in Furniture · only they can be invited without a reason

g.text: Only 2 Furniture suppliers are prequalified and this method needs 3 quotes. Add a supplier
with a reason, or wait for Mpumudde's prequalification.
Local workshop 2 km from the site; Furniture prequalification round opens in

svg.text: 3 suppliers will receive the RFQ by email and in the supplier portal.
